description: RFC 8785 canonical form (general cases and the Grant profile). Text in, canonical text and grant hash out, or a named refusal.

cases.title: member order is by UTF-16 code units, not by code point
plain member order and nested arrays keep their order
string escapes: controls as \u00xx lowercase, solidus unescaped, U+007F and U+2028 literal
integers, negative zero and exponent forms become plain integers
RFC 8785 appendix B number table
empty containers, whitespace and \u escapes of ASCII are insignificant
non-ASCII text is emitted literally (no \u escapes above U+001F)
a duplicate member name is refused, not resolved
a lone surrogate escape is refused
a trailing comma is refused
a leading zero is refused
NaN and Infinity are not JSON
a valid agent Grant in authoring order with indentation
the same Grant with every member order reversed and no whitespace: same canonical text, same hash
a revocation successor (empty validity interval) is a valid Grant
an unknown top-level field is refused
a missing field (conditions) is refused
a fractional number is refused (count.max 1.5)
an integer above 2^53-1 is refused (issuedAt)
an amount written as a JSON number is refused (amounts are decimal strings)
an amount with a leading zero is refused
a mixed-case address is refused (addresses are lowercase)
grantor equal to subject is refused
tiers that do not ascend are refused
a bounded last tier is refused (the last tier is unbounded)
an unknown condition field is refused, never evaluated as false
an unknown condition operator is refused
version 1 with a prior hash is refused
limits that do not cover every scope asset are refused
a version 1 Grant with an empty validity interval is refused
a duplicate member name inside a Grant is refused
cumulative below per-transaction is refused
a required approval book that belongs to the subject is refused: an agent cannot be its own approver
a book of another ADI that only shares the subject name as a prefix is not the subject book
a sub-ADI of the subject as a required book is refused (host name.subject-host)
a deeper sub-ADI with a path is refused too
the subject ADI itself as a required book is refused
a deeper path under the subject ADI is refused
a grantor that is a sub-ADI of the subject is refused like the subject itself
an integer written as 1.0 is refused
an integer written as 4e0 is refused
negative zero is refused
count.max below one is refused
an empty any is refused (an empty all is the explicit no-condition)
more than 64 scope entries is refused by name
more than 16 tiers is refused by name
more than 16 required books in a tier is refused by name
a Grant text above 65,536 bytes is refused before it is parsed
a duplicate scope asset is refused
a duplicate required book in a tier is refused
a grantor key book outside the grantor ADI is refused
a valid registration (certen.subject/v2) in authoring order
a registration with version written 1.0 is refused
a registration with an unknown member is refused
a valid envelope in canonical form
an envelope with an integer-valued number spelled 1.0 is refused
an envelope with an unknown member is refused
a data entry whose two elements are the canonical Grant and the canonical envelope
element 0 that is the Grant but not its canonical bytes is refused
element 1 that is the envelope but not its canonical bytes is refused
an entry with one element is refused
an element that is not UTF-8 text is refused
element 0 that is valid JSON but not a Grant does not decode
an envelope whose hash is another Grant hash is refused
a registration entry in certen-subjects: canonical registration and its envelope
a registration text above 8,192 bytes is refused before it is parsed
an envelope with more than 16 signatures is refused by name
an envelope text above 16,384 bytes is refused before it is parsed
a valid acceptance (the subject accepts a principal and its registry)
a revocation of the acceptance is the same object with action revoke
a registry that is not the principal certen-subjects account is refused
an unknown member is refused
a principal that is a sub-ADI of the subject is refused
an acceptance entry has exactly one element, the canonical text
an acceptance entry with two elements is refused
an acceptance entry that is not the canonical bytes is refused
an acceptance entry that is not UTF-8 text is refused
an acceptance without its principal member is refused by name
an acceptance text above 2,048 bytes is refused before it is parsed
the operator ne on an address is in the closed set
the operator nin on an action kind is in the closed set
every one of the eight operators is allowed on an amount
the operator neq is not in the closed set (ne is)
an order operator on an address is refused: addresses take eq ne in nin only
an amount value that is not decimal text is refused as an invalid value
an in list with a duplicate value is refused as an invalid value
an empty in list is refused as an invalid value
an hour above 23 is refused as an invalid value
a condition nested deeper than 8 levels is condition_too_large
a condition of more than 64 nodes is condition_too_large
a registration of version 1 that carries a prior hash is a lineage error
a registration of version 2 without a prior hash is a lineage error
a Grant that lists the raw action is valid when its native asset carries limits and approvals
the raw action listed twice is refused like any duplicate action
an action kind outside the closed set stays refused: raw is the fourth kind and the last
a condition on action.kind may name raw
